Welcome to saber ! How may I help you?

To reprint a bill, click on the ‘Reprint’ button. This action will load the previously billed details into a pop-up screen. From this screen, you can select the option to print the service bill, deduct bill, or take a thermal print by clicking the respective print button.

![Reprint Process](http://staging.helpybo.com/media/products/Screenshot_2025-02-13_114401.png)
